description: High-confidence validation of CONSIDERED-CONTRACT v1 syntax, references, and internal consistency. Visual and state behavior belongs in the independent review packet.

S1.name: Blocker
S1.definition: User cannot make the decision, is likely to make a wrong one, an accessibility gate fails, or a destructive action is unsafely presented.

S2.name: Major
S2.definition: Decision is possible but materially slower or error-prone.

S3.name: Minor
S3.definition: Adds friction or inconsistency without threatening the decision.

S4.name: Polish
S4.definition: Craft refinement with no functional impact.

rules.name: Contract syntax and completeness
rules.check: The contract block exists, every required field is present, and every declared record parses under the v1 grammar.
rules.fix: Use assets/templates/contract-block.md exactly, or provide the .considered/STRUCTURE.md sidecar.

rules.name: Visual rank equals logical rank
rules.check: Compare the logical rank order of the top 8 elements with the observed visual rank order. Top 3 must match.
rules.fix: Re-encode. Promote the logically top element; demote chrome and decoration.

rules.name: Module size derives from priority
rules.check: No two elements of different tiers share the same footprint by default.
rules.fix: Assign module spans from the tier span map before layout.

rules.name: Encoding budget respected
rules.check: Sum device points per element: position 2, size 2, weight 1, color 2, enclosure 1, whitespace 1, motion 3. P0 4-6, P1 2-3, P2 1-2, P3 0-1, P4 0.
rules.fix: Remove redundant encodings from over-emphasized elements.

rules.name: Only one element exceeds 4 points
rules.check: Count elements with device points greater than 4. Must be at most 1.
rules.fix: Demote all but the intended P0.

rules.name: Exactly one P0
rules.check: Count P0 elements in A5. Must equal 1.
rules.fix: Split the view or demote the competing element.

rules.name: P1 count between 3 and 5
rules.check: Count P1 elements in A5.
rules.fix: Demote surplus P1s or split the view into tabs.

rules.name: Every action is tiered
rules.check: Every row in A6 has a tier.
rules.fix: Run the tier assignment procedure on untiered actions.

rules.name: Monotonic emphasis decay
rules.check: Highest emphasis at a narrower scope is strictly lower than at the enclosing scope.
rules.fix: Lower the treatment rank of the narrower-scope action.

rules.name: Overflow beyond three
rules.check: Any scope with more than 3 actions places the surplus in overflow, ordered by frequency.
rules.fix: Move low-frequency actions into a menu.

rules.name: Destructive is never the default primary
rules.check: No destructive action carries the primary tier outside a destruction-purposed scope.
rules.fix: Demote to tertiary with danger treatment in a separated zone.

rules.name: Grouping implies relationship
rules.check: Grouped actions operate on the same object at the same scope.
rules.fix: Split false groups.

rules.name: Destructive separation
rules.check: Destructive actions are separated from constructive ones by divider, position, or overflow.
rules.fix: Add separation or move to a danger zone.

rules.name: All action states defined
rules.check: Each action defines default, hover, focus, active, loading, disabled, and error behavior.
rules.fix: Specify the missing states.

rules.name: No orphan elements
rules.check: Every element traces to a ranked question in A2.
rules.fix: Delete the orphan. Do not invent a justifying question.

rules.name: Group by question and object
rules.check: Zones cluster elements answering the same question or acting on the same object.
rules.fix: Re-run the grouping procedure from step 3.

rules.name: Group size 3 to 7
rules.check: Each zone holds between 3 and 7 elements.
rules.fix: Merge undersized zones; subdivide oversized ones.

rules.name: No duplication across zones
rules.check: Each element appears in exactly one zone.
rules.fix: Assign to the zone of the highest-ranked question it answers.

rules.name: Heading test
rules.check: Every zone heading is a user-language question, object, or decision. Overview, Metrics, KPIs, Charts, Tables, Other and Analytics are banned.
rules.fix: Rewrite the heading; if impossible, the group is not real.

rules.name: Maximum 3 nav levels
rules.check: Navigation hierarchy depth is 3 or fewer.
rules.fix: Replace the fourth level with in-page tabs or filtering.

rules.name: Default view answers top questions fully
rules.check: The default view completely answers the top-ranked questions rather than partially answering all.
rules.fix: Defer lower-ranked questions behind disclosure.

rules.name: Three-level disclosure limit
rules.check: Routinely needed answers are reachable within 2 disclosure levels.
rules.fix: Restructure; promote frequently needed content.

rules.name: Define once, reachable everywhere
rules.check: Every metric has one definition, reachable from every place it appears.
rules.fix: Add an info affordance bound to a single definition source.

rules.name: Time framing and freshness
rules.check: Time-sensitive values state their window and last-updated time.
rules.fix: Add window and freshness labels.

rules.name: Four-layer structure
rules.check: The view implements orient, state, explain, act in reading order with decreasing weight.
rules.fix: Add the missing layer. Act is the most commonly missing.

rules.name: Do not mix dashboard types
rules.check: One declared type per view.
rules.fix: Split into separate linked views.

rules.name: Module budget
rules.check: Module count is within the declared type budget: operational 6-10, analytical 8-12, strategic 4-6, embedded 3-6.
rules.fix: Delete or defer modules to reach the budget.

rules.name: KPI qualification gate
rules.check: Elements at P0 or P1 pass at least 4 of 5 gates: owner, decision, baseline, actionability, sensitivity.
rules.fix: Demote or delete metrics scoring 3 or fewer.

rules.name: Every value carries context
rules.check: Each displayed value has a target, a prior-period comparison, a trend with magnitude, or a distribution position.
rules.fix: Add the comparison basis.

rules.name: So-what test
rules.check: For each zone, a one-sentence takeaway can be written.
rules.fix: Remove or restructure zones with no takeaway.

rules.name: Empty states are distinct
rules.check: Empty first-use differs from empty filtered in copy and offered action.
rules.fix: Write distinct copy and actions for each.

rules.name: Extremes verified
rules.check: Verified against zero, one, many, very many, negative, null, and very long strings.
rules.fix: Fix layout and formatting for the failing case.

rules.name: Freshness budget
rules.check: Each data source declares expected freshness and a designed stale state.
rules.fix: Declare the budget and design the stale indicator.

rules.name: Assigned roll provenance
rules.check: ROLL records three structure ids, one direction id, a cns reproduction key, and a generation so the assigned hand is replayable.
rules.fix: Run scripts/roll.mjs and record the exact assigned hand.
rules.note: Source EVAL-04 ('two structural options minimum') is intentionally not carried forward: assignment replaces option-generation in this project's architecture. See README Attribution.

rules.name: Compressed chain minimum
rules.check: If code is demanded immediately, an abbreviated A2, A4, A5, A6 precedes it.
rules.fix: Emit the compressed chain above the code.

rules.name: Declare deletions
rules.check: The output states what was requested but removed, and why.
rules.fix: Add the deleted list.
